effect.shortEffect: Prevents the opponent from using any moves that have priority, such as Quick Attack.
effect.full: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon’s head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

french.sv: Une étrange queue recouvre la tête du Pokémon,\nce qui empêche ce dernier et ses alliés d’être visés\npar une capacité prioritaire.

english.sv: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

japanese.sv: 頭を包む　謎のしっぽが こちらに　むかって　先制技を 出せない　ようにする。
